mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY (USER_ID, ROLE, MESSAGE, ROOM_ID, REG_DATE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{role}, #{message}, #{roomId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_ID as roomId, MESSAGE as message, MAX(REG_DATE) as regDate FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY ROOM_ID ORDER BY regDate DESC
SELECT ROLE as role, MESSAGE as message FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY REG_DATE ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CAMP_CHAT_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
